storage_mode.description: Journal storage mode — 'auto', 'persistent', 'volatile', or 'none'. Choose 'persistent' to keep logs across reboots.

system_max_use.description: Maximum disk space used by all journal files (e.g., '10%', '2G', '500M'). Defaults to 10% of filesystem size, capped at 4G.

system_max_file_size.description: Maximum size per system journal file before rotation.

system_max_files.description: Maximum number of journal files per stream before rotation. Defaults to 100.

max_file_sec.description: Maximum age of individual journal files before rotation (duration, e.g., '7d', '1month'). Defaults to 1 month.

max_retention_sec.description: How long journal entries are retained. Set to '0' to rely on disk usage limits.

sync_interval_sec.description: How often to sync journal metadata to disk (duration, e.g., '30s', '10m'). Defaults to 5 minutes.

rate_limit_burst.description: Maximum log messages allowed in the rate-limit interval. Defaults to 10000.

remote_forward_enabled.description: Enable forwarding to remote syslog (e.g., rsyslog) over the network.

forward_to_kmsg.description: Forward journal entries to kernel ring buffer (dmesg).

forward_to_console.description: Forward journal entries to system consoles (not recommended — use with caution).

console_level.description: Minimum log level forwarded to consoles — 'debug', 'info', 'notice', 'warning', 'err', 'crit', 'alert', 'emerg'. Defaults to 'info'. (Mapped to MaxLevelConsole=).

max_file_descriptors.description: Maximum file descriptors for journal clients (increase for many services).

extra_fields.description: Additional static fields to include in all journal entries (e.g., environment tags). Note: 'ExtraFields' is a systemd 247+ feature. This config uses the legacy syntax style but maps to the documented 'Additional fields' concept if supported, or is kept as a placeholder for future compatibility. However, the man page does not explicitly list 'ExtraFields=' in the options section provided. It lists 'Fields' in some contexts but standard journald.conf does not have a simple 'ExtraFields' directive in older versions. In systemd 247+, `ExtraFields=` was added. We keep it as it is a documented feature in recent versions.

use_wall_clock.description: Use wall-clock (real-time) timestamps instead of monotonic clock. Defaults to 'no' (monotonic).

runtime_state_dir.description: Directory for runtime journal state (e.g., sockets, headers).

buffer_size.description: Size of in-memory journal buffer (e.g., '16M'). Defaults to 16M. (Mapped to BufferMax=).

read_kmsg.description: Read kernel messages from /dev/kmsg. Defaults to yes in the default namespace.

audit.description: Enable kernel auditing. Defaults to on.

line_max.description: Maximum line length to permit when converting stream logs into record logs. Defaults to 48K.

compress.description: Compression algorithm or threshold. Takes a boolean value or a size threshold (e.g., 512, 1K, 1M). If enabled (default), data objects larger than 512 bytes are compressed.

split_mode.description: How to split journals: 'uid' (per user), 'none' (single journal). Defaults to 'uid'.
